Filed by the director seat (objectstack #12708, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`) executing decision batch #153 item 4 — maintainer 「其他同意」 to **1** on objectstack#18406: the spec's `ListMapConfigSchema` declares `style` (the map style URL, the Mapbox / MapLibre name), matching objectui's own `ObjectMapConfigSchema` and `getMapConfig` (`packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` reads `schema.map?.style`).

## The defect

objectui#5017's dev warning tells an author to write `map: { mapStyle }`. Nothing reads `mapStyle`: the renderer reads `style`, objectui's schema declares `style`, and the spec (after objectstack#18406 lands) declares `style`. An author who follows the warning writes a key that is silently ignored.

## Ask

- The warning text (and any docs sentence that repeats it) teaches `style`; a pin asserts the warning names `style` and not `mapStyle`.
- ⛔ No new key, no alias. `Clause-②: no`. Changeset patch on `@object-ui/plugin-map` if the warning string is user-visible, else `skip-changeset`.
